symptom: Any write of a domain model (even rewriting a sibling entity) drops LocalizeDate from every DateTime attribute in the unit; external entity rewrites also rewrite Source/Key/Parts marker 2 -> 3
cause: attributeTypeToGen emitted DateTimeAttributeType without LocalizeDate and attributeTypeFromGen never read it; Rest$ODataKeyPart had no registered list marker so the encoder default 3 applied
insight: A whole-unit rewrite re-serializes every sibling from the struct, so a property the struct cannot hold is lost on EVERY entity of the module, not just the edited one. Absent LocalizeDate means Mendix's default true (mxcli wrote it absent for years), so the reader must map absent to true or the fix would unlocalize every mxcli-authored DateTime. Only a Studio Pro fixture with DateTime attributes (TestApp) shows it
